description: What a `faq` `filter` does when the node has no contracted index. esm-schema defines the filter as the predicate that restricts which index combinations contribute a term, a combination for which it is false contributing the additive identity; with no contracted index each output cell is one combination, so a false predicate makes that cell 0̄. Rust and Python applied it; Julia's array-equation path dropped it (its expression-position path applied it), so the same document meant different numbers in different bindings.
